entities.name: PMID:25429902
observations: Clinical Transplantation 2015 observational analysis of 50 heart-transplant recipients; immune-monitoring ATP assay at 63.7 ± 16.4 days and matched baseline/1-year IVUS.

entities.name: Early IM and IVUS progression
observations: In 50 heart-transplant recipients, higher early ATP-release immune-monitoring quartiles tracked greater 1-year IVUS progression in maximal intimal area, stenosis, plaque volume, and maximal intimal thickness.

At cutoff 406 ng ATP/mL, rapid MIT progression ≥0.5 mm occurred in 10/12 elevated-IM patients versus 5/38 lower-IM patients; reported RR 11.7, p<0.001. Observational association does not establish causation.
